study_identification.title: Probing individual-level structural atrophy in frontal glioma patients

deviation_metric.answer: Voxel-wise W-score (|W|>6) and whole-brain abnormality indexes: ipsilateral/contralateral/non-cancer/relative atrophy ratios (GM and WM)
deviation_metric.reason: Deviation quantified by W-scores and summarized into predefined atrophy ratios.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Spearman correlations with tumor volume, CCI, MOCA; two-sample t-tests for categorical biomarkers (IDH, 1p/19q, TERT, MGMT, histological grade); FDR correction.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Patients show unique non-tumoral atrophy patterns with shared MTL involvement; abnormality indexes relate to tumor size and differ by IDH, 1p/19q, and TERT status.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: GM/WM relative atrophy ratios negatively correlated with tumor volume (power-law; r ≈ -0.671 and -0.684; both p<0.0001) and remained after excluding grade III/IV. WM contralateral atrophy ratio differed by IDH mutation status; WM relative atrophy ratio differed by 1p/19q co-deletion; GM and WM relative atrophy ratios differed by TERT mutation status; no significant relationships with MOCA, MGMT, or CCI.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Uncertain optimal W-score threshold (used |W|>6); sex and TIV not well matched between patients and controls; inclusion of perifocal edema in tumor masks may affect WM indexes, especially in high-grade lesions.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: SAM-based indexes may aid presurgical inference of glioma molecular markers and highlight risk for cognitive impairment; single-site implementation on routine T1 images suggests feasibility.

general_notes.general_notes: All participants were right-handed. Single Philips Ingenia 3T scanner. Tumor segmentation performed on T2-FLAIR in ITK-SNAP with manual correction; tumor masks included perifocal edema. Preprocessing via CAT12 with MNI normalization (optimized shooting) and 4-mm FWHM smoothing; SPM templates used for masking. SAM masked to non-tumoral regions using SPM priors (threshold 0.2).
